target.title: test(shared): add unit tests for human-readable list formatting
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `formatHumanList` function formats arrays into human-readable disjunctions ("a, b, or c"). Without tests, the multi-branch formatting logic could silently regress.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add unit tests covering empty, single, two-element, three-element, and four-element arrays.

## User Impact

Human-readable list formatting now has comprehensive test coverage.

## Evidence

Direct behavior probe with real function calls:

```text
$ node --import tsx -e "import('./src/shared/human-list.js').then(({formatHumanList})=>console.log(JSON.stringify([{i:['apple','banana'],r:formatHumanList(['apple','banana']),e:'apple or banana'},{i:['a','b','c'],r:formatHumanList(['a','b','c']),e:'a, b, or c'}])))"
[{"i":["apple","banana"],"r":"apple or banana","e":"apple or banana"},{"i":["a","b","c"],"r":"a, b, or c","e":"a, b, or c"}]
```

Targeted test:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/shared/human-list.test.ts

Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  5 passed (5)
  Duration  364ms
```

Formatting:

```text
$ npx oxfmt --check src/shared/human-list.ts src/shared/human-list.test.ts
Checking formatting...

All matched files use the correct format.
Finished in 69ms on 2 files using 8 threads.
```

```text
$ git diff --check
```
